short_sword.name: Short Sword
short_sword.desc: Your starting blade. Quick, but short.

long_sword.name: Long Sword
long_sword.desc: Reaches further and hits harder than the short sword.

giant_blade.name: Giant Blade
giant_blade.desc: Storm-iron as long as you are tall. Slow, but every cut sweeps a huge arc, high and low.

dragon_slayer.name: Dragon Slayer
dragon_slayer.desc: The only blade that can wound the Evil One. It hums near meteor flesh.

small_shield.name: Small Shield
small_shield.desc: Hold Block to guard (halves damage). Tap it just before a hit to parry.

battle_suit.name: Battle Suit
battle_suit.desc: The Drowned Warden's harness of bronze and spring-stone: take 60% less damage.

full_plate.name: Full Plate
full_plate.desc: Elf-forged plate, light as leaf-silk: take 45% less damage.

large_shield.name: Large Shield
large_shield.desc: Guarding blocks 70% of a hit. Parries work as before.

magic_shield.name: Magic Shield
magic_shield.desc: Guards 70%. A parry catches small shots, even sap and molten rock, and flings them back at your foes.

battle_helmet.name: Battle Helmet
battle_helmet.desc: The elf kings' war-helm, hidden at the meteor's threshold: one more mask of health, and 10% less damage on top of your armor.

jack_key.name: Jack Key
jack_key.desc: Opens one Jack door. Jack doors guard treasure.

queen_key.name: Queen Key
queen_key.desc: Opens one Queen door, the red-lacquered vaults past the Trunk.

king_key.name: King Key
king_key.desc: Opens one King door, the iron vaults in the high branches.

ace_key.name: Ace Key
ace_key.desc: Opens one Ace door, the elf-silver vaults of the outer world.

life_fruit.name: Life Fruit
life_fruit.desc: Two fruits grow a new mask of health.

ointment.name: Ointment
ointment.desc: Rub it on from the pause menu: nothing can hurt you for 10 seconds. You can carry three.

elixir.name: Elixir
elixir.desc: If you fall, it revives you where you stand. You can carry one.

temper_1.name: Temper Blade I
temper_1.desc: The smith folds your blade in dwarf fire: +15% damage.

temper_2.name: Temper Blade II
temper_2.desc: A second folding, a Meteor Shard beaten into the steel: another +15%.

chart_eolis.name: Chart of Eolis
chart_eolis.desc: Every street and hall of Eolis, inked on your map, even those you have not walked.

chart_trunk.name: Chart of the Trunk Hollows
chart_trunk.desc: The tunnels of the Trunk Hollows outlined on your map. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_tower.name: Chart of the Tower
chart_tower.desc: The galleries of the Tower of Trunk outlined on your map. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_mist.name: Chart of the Mist
chart_mist.desc: The drowned marsh of the Mist outlined on your map, as far as the fog let the skywatchers see. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_branches.name: Chart of the Branches
chart_branches.desc: The boughs of the Branches outlined on your map. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

chart_daybreak.name: Chart of Daybreak
chart_daybreak.desc: The sky isles of Daybreak outlined on your map, as the bell-ringers see them. Rooms you have not seen show dimmed.

fire_scroll.name: Fire Scroll
fire_scroll.desc: Teaches Fire: a fireball thrown in an arc that bursts on what it meets and burns away bramble. The Next Spell button switches spells.

tilte_scroll.name: Tilte Scroll
tilte_scroll.desc: Teaches Tilte: a spirit orb that wakes, chooses the nearest foe and flies to it. The Next Spell button switches spells.

warden_dye.name: Warden Green
warden_dye.desc: The deep green the Elven wardens wove. The cloak you set out in.

ember_dye.name: Ember Red
ember_dye.desc: Red as the forge-coals of Forepaw.

tide_dye.name: Tide Blue
tide_dye.desc: The blue of the springs running again.

dusk_dye.name: Dusk Violet
dusk_dye.desc: The color of the Mist at the hour the lanterns are lit.

ash_dye.name: Ash Grey
ash_dye.desc: Bleached pale, like the dwarves' old banners.

saffron_dye.name: Saffron
saffron_dye.desc: Daybreak's bell-ringers wear it on festival mornings.

night_dye.name: Night
night_dye.desc: Nearly black, with a violet sheen under the moon.

lord_dye.name: Lord's Gold
lord_dye.desc: Woven with light. Only for one who has seen the whole of the World Tree.

slate_dye.name: Mantra Slate
slate_dye.desc: The grey of the trial pillars. Earned within the Mantra of Walls.

coral_dye.name: Ledge Coral
coral_dye.desc: Bright as a last step taken late. Earned within the Mantra of Edges.

thorn_dye.name: Thorn Rose
thorn_dye.desc: A deep rose, struck from every bulb. Earned within the Mantra of Thorns.

jade_dye.name: Wind Jade
jade_dye.desc: Light and quick, like the currents. Earned within the Mantra of Winds.

frost_dye.name: Still Frost
frost_dye.desc: The pale blue of water held still. Earned within the Mantra of Stillness.

plummet_dye.name: Plummet Umber
plummet_dye.desc: The brown of a long fall's last ledge. Earned within the Mantra of Falling.
